B41_vs_mean_A.method: Resample the two A seeds then paired complete games within each cell; share case draws between noise variants. The single B endpoint is fixed, with no estimate of B training-seed variability. Equal weight per cell and A seed. Undefined recheck ratios remain undefined, not zero.

B41_synthetic_identifier_forms.method: Read-only AST audit, including compound predicates; no scoring changes.

training.definition: Post-hoc raw exact-name reference audit; identifiers and quoted names must match a candidate literally. It includes malformed ASK bodies, which are still INVALID with zero EIG. A raw name reference is not proof of intended enumeration. Legal item-equality enumeration remains the unchanged primary metric.

endpoint.definition: Post-hoc raw exact-name reference audit; identifiers and quoted names must match a candidate literally. It includes malformed ASK bodies, which are still INVALID with zero EIG. A raw name reference is not proof of intended enumeration. Legal item-equality enumeration remains the unchanged primary metric.

definitions.ambiguous_guess_rate: Games with a GUESS at displayed k>1, divided by all 28 games; exact positive support at p=0, threshold-plus-MAP display at p=.1.
definitions.no_guess_rate: Games without GUESS divided by all 28 games.
definitions.early_guess_wins: Correct guesses using fewer than ceil(log2(N)) questions; counts, with early-guess attempts also reported.
definitions.EIG: Sum of exact question EIG divided by counted questions, including losses and INVALID.
definitions.uncertainty: Whole-game paired intervals condition on endpoints. The A mean comparison resamples two A seeds; no B training-seed variance is estimable.
